name: Becoming Weak
overview: Scripture reveals that human weakness is met by God's sustaining strength, as those who wait on the Lord are renewed and empowered to persevere without fainting (Isaiah 40:31). God promises His presence and support, strengthening and upholding His people in their times of need (Isaiah 41:10). Through faith in Jesus Christ, believers receive peace with God and are enabled to do all things by His strengthening power (Romans 5:1; Philippians 4:13). Thus, weakness becomes an opportunity to experience divine strength and grace.
